Title: Support for IaaS under Azure Resource Manager in Australia and Brazil regions

Body.Content:
We are announcing support for Azure Compute, Network, and Storage Providers (IaaS) under Azure Resource Manager in Australia East, Australia Southeast, and Brazil South starting today. This enables you to use template-based deployment of virtual machines with extensions, software-defined networks, and storage accounts with RBAC in those regions.
  • For more information, see Azure Compute, Network, and Storage Providers under the Azure Resource Manager.
  • For sample templates, check out Azure Quickstart Templates.
Body.Markdown:
We are announcing support for Azure Compute, Network, and Storage Providers (IaaS) under Azure Resource Manager in Australia East, Australia Southeast, and Brazil South starting today. This enables you to use template-based deployment of virtual machines with extensions, software-defined networks, and storage accounts with RBAC in those regions.

For more information, see Azure Compute, Network, and Storage Providers under the Azure Resource Manager .

For sample templates, check out Azure Quickstart Templates .
